spec.source: R69 historical K27 N8 probabilities; no fresh transformer; two same-size checkpoints; 3 leave-seed folds; artificial region; 24 unique names, repeated across checkpoints; fixed ridge .01, 160 gradient steps per selected bias head; tree trained by alternating extreme mean log ratios then balanced splits; DP exact only on this tree and additive surrogate, single greedy not globally optimal; SD surrogate iid within block and assumed head startup=4 coordinate units; synthetic Markov transition (s*31+y+1)%test.length; 128 sequences/fold,32 tokens, B4 no bonus; matched AR path uses same candidates on committed steps; all candidate head rows counted, no network/GPU timing; head dispatch can share across block, AR baseline single causal stream; independent requests can batch AR; not a true model or FL deployment.
